newsitem.title: GREECE: DELTA INFORM SEES 20PCT PROFIT GROWTH IN 97.
newsitem.headline: DELTA INFORM SEES 20PCT PROFIT GROWTH IN 97.

text.p: Delta Informatics told shareholders it will pay a dividend per share of 120 drachmas for fiscal 1996 versus 100 a year earlier and forecast 20 percent sales and profit growth this year.
Its directors forecast turnover and earnings growth of 20 percent in 1997.
On a parent company basis, Delta Informatics' pre-tax earnings rose 29.1 percent to 1.33 billion drachmas in 1996. Sales were up 64.3 percent to 3.52 billion.
Cost of goods sold increased 59 percent to 2.06 billion drachmas mainly due to investments carried out to prepare for Greece's September 1996 general elections.
This is the main reason for depreciation charges doubling to 0.5 billion drachmas, management said.

A plan for a rights issue this year will seek shareholder approval again in a new meeting in 20 days as Tuesday's general assembly failed to reach a quorum needed to approve the plan. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
